records.title: Shell jobs fail only when the worker runs as a service
records.report: Jobs exit immediately under systemd but run from an interactive terminal. Trace output reaches a console-cleanup command.

source.note: Primary first-person discussion reviewed through indexed source text. Outcome is reported, not independently reproduced.

unsuccessfulSteps.step: Match the interactive PATH and working directory.
unsuccessfulSteps.evidence: The reporter said jobs still failed under the service.

unsuccessfulSteps.step: Use a repository-specific worker instead of a shared worker.

outcome.fix: The reporter removed the non-interactive console cleanup from the worker account’s logout profile.
outcome.verification: The original reporter marked the issue solved after identifying clear_console in the Debian logout profile.
outcome.limitations: Historical Debian behavior. Inspect the actual profile; do not run the service as root to bypass the problem.

records.title: The web UI works over HTTPS but build jobs cannot connect
records.report: A self-managed installation behind Apache is accessible in the browser, while its Docker worker fails to run a simple job.

source.note: Primary first-person discussion reviewed through indexed source text. Outcome is reported, not independently reproduced.

unsuccessfulSteps.step: Pass the certificate full chain to the worker.
unsuccessfulSteps.evidence: The reported error changed, but the job still did not work.

outcome.fix: The reporter corrected Apache’s upstream port and the application’s matching local listener.
outcome.verification: The reporter explicitly confirmed recovery after aligning ports 8080 and 8181.
outcome.limitations: The particular port values are historical configuration details, not universal defaults. Confirm the current routing before changes.

records.title: A newly registered container worker never connects
records.report: Registration succeeds, but the worker remains disconnected and job polling reports forbidden.

source.note: Primary first-person discussion reviewed through indexed source text. Outcome is reported, not independently reproduced.

unsuccessfulSteps.step: Replace the stored worker token with the website registration token.
unsuccessfulSteps.evidence: The reporter identified that edit as corrupting the configuration.

outcome.fix: The reporter registered again and started the container with the correct persistent configuration mount.
outcome.verification: Original poster confirmed the connection worked after restoring the mount and re-registering.
outcome.limitations: Do not substitute registration tokens for issued worker credentials. Source logs show a historical 12.9.1 image; deployment version applicability must be checked.

records.title: Workers stop polling after a server upgrade
records.report: After upgrading a self-managed server, existing workers receive forbidden responses and jobs no longer run.

source.note: Primary first-person discussion reviewed through indexed source text. Outcome is reported, not independently reproduced.

outcome.fix: The reporter completed reconfiguration after addressing a KAS configuration problem, then upgraded to 17.1.
outcome.verification: The original reporter stated that existing jobs resumed. Several changes were made, so the individual effective step is not isolated.
outcome.limitations: This is a multi-change recovery report. Disabling KAS is inappropriate when Kubernetes-agent functionality is required. Do not infer that matching versions alone fixed authentication.

records.title: Files visible in a build are missing inside its service container
records.report: A Docker Compose setup works locally, but CI service containers cannot find configuration files visible to the job.

source.note: Primary first-person discussion reviewed through indexed source text. Outcome is reported, not independently reproduced.

outcome.fix: The reporter aligned the shared build directory and volume mappings so service containers could access the files.
outcome.verification: Original poster reported that the workflow ran after configuring shared storage.
outcome.limitations: Their configuration also used privileged execution and a Docker socket. Those powerful settings are not a general recommendation; assess the required isolation before reuse.

records.title: Large output uploads fail from Windows containers
records.report: Large artifact uploads fail with a connection reset in a Windows container, while a PowerShell worker succeeds.

source.note: Primary first-person discussion reviewed through indexed source text. Outcome is reported, not independently reproduced.

outcome.fix: The reporter changed the Windows container MTU from 1350 to 1500.
outcome.verification: The original poster said the change appeared to resolve the upload issue; confirmation is qualified.
outcome.limitations: Do not copy this MTU into another network. Measure the actual path and container network; the report establishes a workaround only.

records.title: GCS cache credentials missing after Helm setup
records.report: Cache setup reports that GCS is configured but credentials are missing. The generated Runner configuration lacks CredentialsFile.

source.note: Reporter documents the secret-key mismatch; a later participant mentions a documentation correction. Exact chart and Runner versions for this reply are not established.

outcome.fix: Align the credential secret file key with the chart configuration; the reporter traced a mismatched spelling in the historical chart instructions.
outcome.verification: Reporter describes this outcome; not independently reproduced. Reporter documents the secret-key mismatch; a later participant mentions a documentation correction. Exact chart and Runner versions for this reply are not established.
outcome.limitations: Historical misspelling must not be copied into modern charts. Inspect generated configuration and expected secret keys.

records.title: SCP succeeds interactively but fails in the deployment job
records.report: SCP works in an interactive session but the deployment job rejects public-key/password authentication.

source.note: First-person public report inspected in search-indexed thread text; direct page fetch unavailable. No independent reproduction.

outcome.fix: The reporter resolved the mismatch after switching to the gitlab-runner user.
outcome.verification: Reporter describes this outcome; not independently reproduced.
outcome.limitations: Executor and credential setup are not fully specified. Check the actual service user and key permissions; do not copy the source example that disables host-key verification.

records.title: Terraform cannot clone a private module in CI
records.report: Terraform module fetch fails with SSH public-key authentication in CI while a local initialization on the runner works.

source.note: Separate first-person reply reports Terraform 0.15.3 and Runner13.11.0. Explicitly says the original issue was not solved.

outcome.fix: Reporter used an authenticated HTTPS module URL as a workaround; the underlying SSH issue remained unresolved.
outcome.verification: Reporter describes this outcome; not independently reproduced. Separate first-person reply reports Terraform 0.15.3 and Runner13.11.0. Explicitly says the original issue was not solved.
outcome.limitations: Use protected credentials; never embed a token in shared source. Workaround does not establish why SSH authentication failed.

records.title: Runner job labels absent from Prometheus resource metrics
records.report: K3s runners deployed by Helm and ArgoCD need job-level resource metrics, but the expected pod labels are not available in the metric series.

source.note: First-person public report inspected in search-indexed thread text; direct page fetch unavailable. No independent reproduction.

outcome.fix: Reporter enabled kube-state-metrics annotation collection and joined those labels to resource metrics with PromQL.
outcome.verification: Reporter describes this outcome; not independently reproduced.
outcome.limitations: Possible bug was only suspected. Label collection has cardinality and information exposure implications; choose required labels rather than copying a wildcard allowlist.

records.title: Docker-machine TLS certificates belong to a different user
records.report: During a DigitalOcean-to-AWS migration, autoscaling creates instances and SSH works, but the remote Docker connection rejects its TLS certificate.

source.note: First-person public report inspected in search-indexed thread text; direct page fetch unavailable. No independent reproduction.

outcome.fix: Reporter regenerated Docker-machine certificates under the same user that runs the Runner service.
outcome.verification: Reporter describes this outcome; not independently reproduced.
outcome.limitations: Docker+machine historical setup. Certificate replacement is disruptive; inventory ownership and backups first. Do not generalize to disabling TLS.

records.title: Windows PowerShell job fails parsing generated variables
records.report: A Windows shell job exits while parsing generated environment-variable assignments before normal job work. Runner16.11.1 is reported. A different participant later says PowerShell7 helped a similar case.

source.note: Original reporter does not confirm a resolution in inspected text. Later PowerShell7 success belongs to another participant and is not treated as this case outcome.

outcome.verification: No confirmed outcome established for this episode in the inspected source.
outcome.limitations: Historical, environment-specific report. Missing versions remain unknown; verify current applicability before changes.

records.title: Windows job image lacks the expected shell executable
records.report: Windows container job fails at CreateProcess with file-not-found. Discussion distinguishes images providing powershell.exe from those with only pwsh.exe.

source.note: Outcome belongs to the confirming participant, not proof for every report in the thread. Exact Runner version for that participant is unknown.

outcome.fix: A participant confirmed success using an image that supplied the expected Windows PowerShell executable.
outcome.verification: Reporter describes this outcome; not independently reproduced. Outcome belongs to the confirming participant, not proof for every report in the thread. Exact Runner version for that participant is unknown.
outcome.limitations: Check host/container OS and configured shell together; historical .NET image tags are not current recommendations.

records.title: Large HTTPS clone fails with early EOF inside Docker
records.report: Large repository clones fail intermittently inside Docker through an nginx TLS reverse proxy with RPC failure and early EOF.

source.note: First-person public report inspected in search-indexed thread text; direct page fetch unavailable. No independent reproduction.

unsuccessfulSteps.step: Checked reverse-proxy timeouts, cipher suites and body limits.
unsuccessfulSteps.evidence: Reporter lists these among unsuccessful investigations.

unsuccessfulSteps.step: Rebuilt Git with OpenSSL and adjusted Docker MTU.
unsuccessfulSteps.evidence: Reporter still needed a different workaround.

outcome.fix: Reporter changed the host conntrack TCP behavior and reported subsequent clones succeeding.
outcome.verification: Reporter describes this outcome; not independently reproduced.
outcome.limitations: Host-wide networking change; not a default recommendation. Historical versions unspecified and no controlled root-cause isolation. Have a network owner verify evidence.

records.title: Stale Docker authentication blocks a public image pull
records.report: A public registry image returns access denied in one user context; a later participant reports encountering this symptom with saved registry authentication.

source.note: Separate first-person reply. Original reporter host details and versions are not attributed to this participant.

outcome.fix: That participant removed an outdated registry entry from the Docker client authentication configuration and reported success.
outcome.verification: Reporter describes this outcome; not independently reproduced. Separate first-person reply. Original reporter host details and versions are not attributed to this participant.
outcome.limitations: Review the specific stale entry and preserve other credentials; do not delete the entire Docker configuration.

records.title: Cross-project image pull denied despite local access
records.report: A common CI image pulls locally but the consuming project cannot pull it in a job.

source.note: First-person public report inspected in search-indexed thread text; direct page fetch unavailable. No independent reproduction.

outcome.fix: Reporter allowed the consuming project in the source project job-token access list, including its full group/subgroup path.
outcome.verification: Reporter describes this outcome; not independently reproduced.
outcome.limitations: Grant only the required project access. Other thread replies use different versions and methods; do not publish a private project or disable access limits.

records.title: Intermittent dependencies disappear across shared Docker runners
records.report: After moving to two shared Docker runners, jobs intermittently lack previously installed dependencies. Retries sometimes help and cache configuration changes give mixed results.

source.note: Interim improvement after disabling caching was followed by continued cache questions. No stable, isolated resolution is established in inspected text.

unsuccessfulSteps.step: Retried individual failed jobs and whole pipelines.
unsuccessfulSteps.evidence: Failures could move to a later job.

unsuccessfulSteps.step: Added cache configuration and restarted containers.
unsuccessfulSteps.evidence: Discussion still reports missing dependencies and uncertainty about effective settings.

outcome.verification: No confirmed outcome established for this episode in the inspected source.
outcome.limitations: Historical, environment-specific report. Missing versions remain unknown; verify current applicability before changes.

records.title: Windows Docker cache archive disappears before restore
records.report: Runner12.1.0 with Docker Desktop2.1.0.1 on Windows appears to remove cache.zip before restoration. The reporter seeks confirmation before filing a bug.

source.note: Observed cache behavior is a reporter hypothesis. No verified outcome was available in inspected thread text.

outcome.verification: No confirmed outcome established for this episode in the inspected source.
outcome.limitations: Historical, environment-specific report. Missing versions remain unknown; verify current applicability before changes.

records.title: Helm runner registration fails with a token in the wrong field
records.report: K3s runner cannot verify against a self-managed GitLab container behind a reverse proxy. Switching URL endpoints did not resolve registration.

source.note: First-person public report inspected in search-indexed thread text; direct page fetch unavailable. No independent reproduction.

unsuccessfulSteps.step: Tried reverse-proxy and direct HTTP/HTTPS endpoints.
unsuccessfulSteps.evidence: Verification failed or direct endpoint refused connections.

outcome.fix: Reporter moved the token to the historical runnerRegistrationToken field and reported success.
outcome.verification: Reporter describes this outcome; not independently reproduced.
outcome.limitations: Historical legacy registration flow. Later GitLab versions use authentication tokens differently; determine version and token type before advice. Do not apply this old field universally.

records.title: Artifact path stops matching after a Runner release change
records.report: Artifact upload reports no matching files after changing from Runner12.10.0-rc2 to13.0.0-rc1; the path is a single dot.

source.note: First-person public report inspected in search-indexed thread text; direct page fetch unavailable. No independent reproduction.

outcome.fix: Reporter changed the artifact path from a single dot to dot-slash and confirmed the upload worked.
outcome.verification: Reporter describes this outcome; not independently reproduced.
outcome.limitations: Release-candidate-specific historical behavior, not evidence for all current releases. Scope artifacts to intended outputs; do not archive an entire checkout blindly.

records.title: Disk-full errors persist after cleanup on a migrated runner
records.report: After migrating a runner, Docker jobs intermittently report disk exhaustion despite available bytes and inodes. Runner18.8.0 appears in the reported logs.

source.note: First-person provisional recovery, not a controlled root-cause proof. Earlier replies include speculative AI-generated explanations; those are excluded from the record.

unsuccessfulSteps.step: Reduced concurrency and changed pull policy and Docker temporary directory.
unsuccessfulSteps.evidence: Reporter said the error continued after these changes.

unsuccessfulSteps.step: Moved temporary storage and pruned images and volumes.
unsuccessfulSteps.evidence: Errors recurred with substantial free space and inodes.

outcome.fix: Reporter discovered an old VM running duplicated Runner IDs, stopped that service and observed pipelines working again, with monitoring still planned.
outcome.verification: Reporter describes this outcome; not independently reproduced. First-person provisional recovery, not a controlled root-cause proof. Earlier replies include speculative AI-generated explanations; those are excluded from the record.
outcome.limitations: Verify the identity and host actually executing the job. Reported recovery was still under observation; do not infer disk cleanup or concurrency is universally ineffective.
